description: This file implements the ResizableDoubleArray class, a dynamic array structure for doubles that expands and contracts automatically, supporting various modes of expansion and contraction. It provides methods for adding, removing, replacing, and accessing elements, as well as managing internal storage capacity and array resizing strategies.

classes.name: ResizableDoubleArray
classes.description: A variable length array for doubles that dynamically resizes with configurable expansion and contraction policies. Supports thread-safe operations for adding, removing, and accessing elements, as well as internal capacity management.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Appends a new element to the end of the array.

methods.name: addElements
methods.description: Adds multiple elements to the end of the array.

methods.name: addElementRolling
methods.description: Adds an element to the end, rolling the array by discarding the front element and returning that discarded value.

methods.name: substituteMostRecentElement
methods.description: Replaces the most recent element with a new value, returning the old value.

methods.name: discardFrontElements
methods.description: Removes a specified number of elements from the front of the array.

methods.name: discardMostRecentElements
methods.description: Removes a specified number of elements from the end of the array.

methods.name: discardExtremeElements
methods.description: Removes elements from either the front or the end depending on parameter.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the array to empty.

methods.name: contract
methods.description: Reduces internal storage to match the size of contained elements plus one.

methods.name: setNumElements
methods.description: Sets the number of elements the array should contain, expanding storage if necessary.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves element at specified index.

methods.name: getElements
methods.description: Returns a copy of the internal elements.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Returns the total internal storage capacity.

methods.name: getNumElements
methods.description: Returns the current number of addressable elements.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this array.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another ResizableDoubleArray.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code for the array object.

methods.name: setExpansionMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of expansion (multiplicative or additive).

methods.name: setExpansionFactor
methods.description: Sets the factor of expansion when resizing.

methods.name: getExpansionFactor
methods.description: Gets the current expansion factor.

methods.name: getExpansionMode
methods.description: Gets the current expansion mode.
